description: This Java source file defines a class Gles2ColoredTriangleList used for rendering a list of triangles with a solid color in OpenGL ES 2.0. It includes inner classes for shader program management, methods for drawing and error checking, and handles vertex buffers and shader compilation.

classes.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
classes.description: A class for rendering solid-colored triangle lists with OpenGL ES 2.0, managing vertex buffers and shaders.

classes.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList.Program
classes.description: Inner class managing the shader program, including compilation, linking, and binding uniforms and attributes.

methods.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
methods.description: Constructor initializing vertex buffer, color data, and shader program.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the triangle list using the specified Model-View-Projection matrix.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Utility method to check for OpenGL errors after GL calls.

methods.description: Compiles a shader of specified type from source code.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Shader program class that compiles, links, and sets up shader attribute and uniform locations.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Sets this shader program as active in OpenGL.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the MVP matrix, vertex buffer, and color uniform to the shader program for drawing.
